title: Viego Blade
description: Unofficial non OptiFine compatibility patch for Viego Blade on Minecraft 1.26.1 adding fallback item and model support for newer versions requires the original resource pack original assets belong to the original creator
body:
This is an unofficial compatibility patch for the Viego Blade resource pack, updated to work on Minecraft 26.1.1 without OptiFine.

The original pack was designed for older Minecraft versions and OptiFine CIT features. This patch adds fallback item/model support so the custom item can properly display on newer versions using modern resource pack systems.

Included:
• Fallback item models
• Compatibility JSON files
• Non-OptiFine support adjustments
• 26.1.1 compatibility fixes

Important:
• This is NOT the original resource pack
• Original assets, designs, and textures belong to the original creator
• Please download and support the original pack author
• This project only exists to improve compatibility for newer Minecraft versions

Do not redistribute this patch without proper credit.
